summary.text: Jim Pierson is a Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 35-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Army veteran who served from 1979 to 1986, he lists his profession as product manager.

paragraphs.text: Jim Pierson graduated from Cerritos High School and served in the U.S. Army from 1979 to 1986, earning a military citation from the Army Special Forces Qualification Course in 1980.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he served seven years in Army Special Forces, including Airborne training and deployments in the Arctic Circle.
Pierson said in the survey that after the military he worked on large technology systems at companies including Apple, Microsoft and GoDaddy.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as product manager.
Pierson said his campaign focuses on practical solutions on housing, healthcare, transportation and utility costs.

He named reducing for-profit healthcare costs, streamlining home-construction permitting, and a tax system with a lower burden on working families and small businesses as policy areas he is passionate about.
